text: This solution, Resilient Homes Fund (RHF) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Australia (State of Queensland) between Queensland Government, Australian Government, Queensland Reconstruction Authority (QRA), Department of Energy and Public Works/Department of Housing, Local Government, Planning and Public Works, Local governments across 39 LGAs, Natural Hazards Research Australia (NHRA), and University of Queensland. The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
